verdict.rationale: The quickstart lists 'agents, and background execution' among its topics, and the release notes mention a Managed Agents public preview. The Batch API also processes large request volumes asynchronously, and function calling lets models trigger real-world actions. Together these give building blocks for background agent work, but the evidence never shows user-configurable automations that run autonomously, and the developer must still assemble the orchestration. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/triggers for recurring automations, details of how background execution and Managed Agents behave, maturity beyond preview, independent hands-on corroboration.
